description: Windah is the first to get the 1400-dollar cockatoo mystery reward, and celebrates with 'Alhamdulillah kita berhasil nyolong' (day 2 stream, idea A6). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-kakatua/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-kakatua.mp4): FOUR parts of stream-1700-1800.mp4 (Windah live QSPPyA1736U, t 0 = 19 Nov 2026 17:00:13 WIB) re-encoded to 1080p30 and joined IN OUTPUT ORDER (so every cut is in source order on one input): part 1 local 0-8 = t 1178-1186; part 2 local 8-16 = t 645-653; part 3 local 16-26 = t 1047-1057; part 4 local 26-38 = t 1153-1165. Cuts: A1178 t 1179.70-1184.85 = local 1.70-6.85 -> output 0.00-5.15; A645 t 647.00-652.10 = local 10.00-15.10 -> output 5.15-10.25; A1047 t 1048.75-1055.55 = local 17.75-24.55 -> output 10.25-17.05; A1153 t 1154.90-1164.05 = local 27.90-37.05 -> output 17.05-26.20. Beats: 17:19:52 'Nice, Alhamdulillah kita berhasil nyolong. Eh nggak pantes nggak sih ngomong gitu. Maksudnya kita lolos dari polisi' (opener, payoff first; 'lolos' is a best guess, whisper heard 'lulus'/'nggak harus jadi'); 17:11:00 'Nah kemarin ada viewer yang DM gue, guys. Ada yang katanya ketinggalan, mau diambil gak?'; 17:18:22 'Guys, gue orang pertama yang dapet 1400 dolar misteri burung kakatua, please jangan kasih tau siapa-siapa'; 17:19:28 reads chat 'bebaskan burungnya, bang', then 'burungnya nggak bisa dibebaskan, jangan percaya bocil burung bebasin, mereka cuma caper doang, burungnya emang udah ditakdirkan dikurung'. Skipped the in-game 'anjing gila' line (t 1176) right before the opener; no guns in the cuts (sneaking, driving, map). Main 26.20 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Clean layout as windah-gtavi-sepatu; hook line 1 Paper 'ALHAMDULILLAH BERHASIL NYOLONG', line 2 Volt 'EH, GAK PANTES WKWK', Audex 58. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
